name: Rejected Suggestion
description: The assistant proposes a venue upgrade; the user explicitly rejects it. The suggestion must NOT appear in the final state.

conversation.content: Book a table for four at Bella Italia for Friday evening.
I can book Bella Italia for four on Friday evening. I also noticed La Maison is available and has a special tasting menu this Friday — would you like me to switch to that instead?
No, stick with Bella Italia please.
Understood, keeping Bella Italia. I'll confirm a table for four on Friday evening.

notes: La Maison was suggested by the assistant but explicitly rejected. The final state must show Bella Italia, not La Maison.
